birds you can recognise
just by their song

blackbird

a slow, fluting melody
at dusk.

robin

sings even in winter,
sometimes at night.

wren

a tiny bird with an
astonishingly loud song.

song thrush

repeats each phrase
two or three times.

cuckoo

the two notes that
announce spring.

chaffinch

a cascade of notes that
ends with a flourish.

five quiet minutes of learning
beat five minutes of scrolling.
